The text of the Qur’an appears to many people desperately muddled and lacking any coherence. This book proposes a systematic presentation of the writing processes (or rhetoric) that ensures, on the contrary, the coherence of the Qur’anic text. The ancient Semitic texts, of which the Qur’an is a part, do not obey the Greek rhetoric. Their basic principle is not a progressive linearity, but symmetry
